relics.name: Conductive Coils
relics.description: +1 weapon damage per stack.

relics.name: Rapid Capacitor
relics.description: +25% attack speed per stack.

relics.name: Steel Sutures
relics.description: +20 maximum vitality; heal 20.

relics.name: Leech Valve
relics.description: Heal 2 vitality on a successful attack per stack.

relics.name: Clockwork Stride
relics.description: +18% movement speed per stack.

relics.name: Phantom Piston
relics.description: Dash recharges 25% faster per stack.

relics.name: Amber Aegis
relics.description: Reduce incoming damage by 2 per stack.

relics.name: Deadeye Lens
relics.description: +15% critical chance per stack. Critical hits deal double damage.

relics.name: Chain Inductor
relics.description: Every fourth coil hit arcs to a nearby visible foe. +1 arc damage per stack.

relics.name: Salvager's Seal
relics.description: +50% salvage from pickups per stack.

relics.name: Cryo Lens
relics.description: Hits slow foes 45% for 2.4s. Extra stacks add 0.8s.

relics.name: Furnace Fuse
relics.description: Hits ignite foes for 2.2s. +1 burn damage per tick per stack.

relics.name: Thorn Aegis
relics.description: Return 1 damage per stack to nearby foes when hurt.

relics.name: Vital Harvest
relics.description: Enemy deaths heal 4 vitality per stack.

relics.name: Voltaic Bloom
relics.description: Kills release a nearby burst. +2 burst damage per stack.

relics.name: Requiem Capacitor
relics.description: +1 skill damage, +0.35m radius, faster skill recharge per stack.

relics.name: Echo Chamber
relics.description: Every third coil hit fires at another visible enemy. Extra stacks add damage.

relics.name: Second Heart
relics.description: Survive one fatal hit at 40% vitality. A new heart replaces a spent one.

relics.name: Pressure Scattergun
relics.description: Unlock a close-range fan blast. Extra stacks add +1 scattergun damage.

relics.name: Funeral Rail
relics.description: Unlock a slow rail shot through aligned foes. Solid cover still stops it. Extra stacks: +1 damage.

relics.name: Cinder Sprayer
relics.description: Unlock a short cone that ignites groups. Extra stacks: +1 cinder damage.

relics.name: Tesla Loom
relics.description: Unlock lightning that jumps between visible foes. Extra stacks: +1 loom damage.

relics.name: Splinter Prism
relics.description: Primary hits split to a second visible foe for 1 damage per stack. 0.4s cooldown.

relics.name: Executioner's Seal
relics.description: Primary attacks deal +50% damage per stack to foes below 30% vitality.

relics.name: Glass Dynamo
relics.description: Deal +40% primary damage, but take +25% damage per stack.

relics.name: Aegis Step
relics.description: Dash grants 8 barrier per stack for 3s. Barrier absorbs damage first.

relics.name: Phantom Wake
relics.description: Dash leaves a 2.5s damaging trail. +1 damage per tick per stack.

relics.name: Quickening Gear
relics.description: Kills shorten the active skill cooldown by 0.8s per stack.

relics.name: Critical Capacitor
relics.description: Critical primary hits shorten skill cooldown by 0.5s per stack.

relics.name: Brittle Memory
relics.description: Primary hits on chilled foes deal +2 damage per stack. 0.6s cooldown.

relics.name: Volatile Wounds
relics.description: Burning foes explode on death for 3 damage per stack. Bursts cannot chain themselves.

relics.name: Static Brand
relics.description: Every third primary hit on one foe detonates a brand for 3 damage per stack.

relics.name: Kill Clock
relics.description: Kills grant +8% attack speed per stack for 6s. Up to five kill charges.

relics.name: Blood Ammunition
relics.description: +2 primary damage per stack. Each attack costs 1 vitality per stack; cannot be fatal.

relics.name: Salvage Plating
relics.description: Salvage pickups grant 2 barrier per stack for 8s. Total barrier is capped at 40.

relics.name: Rupture Core
relics.description: Equip Rupture: blast, stun and intercept projectiles. Each stack also improves skill power.

relics.name: Stasis Core
relics.description: Equip Stasis: a 5s field slows and interrupts foes. Each stack also improves skill power.

relics.name: Furnace Core
relics.description: Equip Furnace: a blast ignites foes and leaves a 4s fire field. Each stack improves skill power.

relics.name: Deadeye Step
relics.description: After a dash, your next attack within 3s is critical and deals +1 damage per stack.

relics.name: Moving Target
relics.description: After moving for 1s, gain +20% attack speed per stack. Stops when you stand still.

relics.name: Ember Siphon
relics.description: Burn damage heals 1 vitality per stack, at most once every 0.6s.

relics.name: Magnetic Heart
relics.description: Increase pickup attraction by 0.8m per stack.

relics.name: Blight Injector
relics.description: Primary hits add poison, up to 5 doses. Each relic stack adds one dose per hit.

relics.name: Relentless Chamber
relics.description: Repeated primary hits on one foe build up to +3 damage per stack. Changing targets resets it.

relics.name: Pressure Guard
relics.description: Casting your active skill grants 12 barrier per stack for 5s.

relics.name: Gambler's Lens
relics.description: +20% critical chance per stack, but incoming hits deal +2 damage per stack.

relics.name: Ghost Spring
relics.description: Dashes recharge 35% faster per stack.

relics.name: Aftershock
relics.description: Your active skill repeats a half-strength blast after 0.8s. Extra stacks add repeat damage.

relics.name: Burst Receiver
relics.description: COIL MOD: successful primary hits fire two delayed follow-up rounds. +1 follow-up damage per stack.

relics.name: Induction Bank
relics.description: COIL MOD: every fifth attack deals +3 primary damage per stack.

relics.name: Long Arc
relics.description: SABER MOD: +0.4m reach per stack, with a matching wider slash.

relics.name: Sundering Edge
relics.description: SABER MOD: strikes make foes vulnerable for 3s. Further primary hits deal +25% damage per stack.

relics.name: Slug Choke
relics.description: SCATTER MOD: a narrower cone deals +4 damage per stack. Trades crowd coverage for focused damage.

relics.name: Concussive Wadding
relics.description: SCATTER MOD: hits interrupt foes for 0.2s per stack.

relics.name: Longshot Capacitor
relics.description: RAIL MOD: hits beyond 4m deal +4 damage per stack.

relics.name: Quick-cycle Breech
relics.description: RAIL MOD: attack 25% faster per stack, but each shot loses 1 damage per stack.

relics.name: Wick Oil
relics.description: CINDER MOD: primary hits extend ignition by 2s per stack.

relics.name: Backdraft Nozzle
relics.description: CINDER MOD: deal +2 damage per stack to an already burning foe. 0.5s cooldown.

relics.name: Forked Circuit
relics.description: TESLA MOD: lightning reaches one additional target per stack.

relics.name: Grounding Rod
relics.description: TESLA MOD: every chain target is slowed. Extra stacks extend the slow.

relics.name: Field Repair
relics.description: Restore 25 vitality immediately. A repeatable supply when other relics are exhausted.

relics.name: Salvage Bond
relics.description: Recover 15 run salvage immediately. A repeatable supply when other relics are exhausted.

relics.name: Aegis Cell
relics.description: Gain 20 barrier for 12s. A repeatable supply when other relics are exhausted.

loadoutDetails:
Mourning Coil + Arc Saber
Rupture skill
Starts with Deadeye Lens and Moving Target.
Precise shots and constant movement.

Cinder Sprayer + Arc Saber
Furnace skill
Starts with Furnace Fuse and Ember Siphon.
Ignite crowds and recover through fire.

Tesla Loom + Arc Saber
Stasis skill
Starts with Static Brand and Quickening Gear.
Control groups and recycle skill cooldowns.
